cases.title: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and v
cases.question:
Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Mornington'), SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Amos'));

cases.title: What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users crea
cases.question:
What is the average of the up votes and the average user age for users creating more than 10 posts?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creating more than 10 post refers to Count (UserId) > 10; average of the up votes = Divide (Sum(UpVotes), Count (UserId)); average age = Divide (Sum(Age), Count(UserId))

cases.title: What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2
cases.question:
What is the percentage difference of student badges given during 2010 and 2011?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: student badges refers to badge's name = 'Student'; during 2010 refers to Year(Date) = 2010; during 2011 refers to Year(Date) = 2011; percentage difference = Subtract (Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2010), Count (Name)) *100, Divide(Count(Name where Year(Date) = 2011), Count(Name)) * 100)
